readings: Inner-join each conservation record to its site on zoneref = zoneregistry, so records with no matching site are dropped. Group by the site's insurstat, with a NULL insurstat as its own 'missing' group. For each group, count the distinct zoneref values among the conservation records. Show insurstat, that count, and the count divided by the sum of the counts over all groups, with no rounding.

Left-join each conservation record to sites on zoneref = zoneregistry, so records whose zoneref has no matching site are kept. Group by the site's insurstat, and put both a NULL insurstat and an unmatched site into one 'missing' group. For each group, count the distinct conservation zoneref values. Show insurstat, that count, and the count divided by the sum of the counts over all groups, with no rounding.
queries:
SELECT COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'missing') AS insurstat,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS zone_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref)) OVER () AS proportion
FROM scanconservation c
JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'missing');
SELECT
  COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'missing') AS insurstat,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS zone_count,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref)) OVER () AS proportion
FROM scanconservation c
LEFT JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'missing');
